frequency_question: How often does a central regulatory body successfully execute and officially notify complex administrative rules within a 28-day court-mandated window?
membership_rule: Includes instances where an apex court sets a final compliance deadline under 30 days for notifying substantive public health or consumer regulations; excludes general legislative enactments and routine administrative delays without court-imposed compressed timelines.

known_gaps: Excludes lower tribunal orders and purely voluntary agency timelines.
skeleton: Not applicable; direct case enumeration used.
multiplier: 2 hits / 5 cases = 40 percent base rate for meeting sub-30-day court-mandated regulatory notification windows.
validity_reason: Administrative bureaucratic velocity and inter-ministerial processing speeds remain relatively stable over medium-term political cycles.
